actions.description: Create a custom category.

policyName.description: The name of the policy to create. Max 32 characters, no special characters (#!@$%^*?./\).

success.description: Whether the URLs were successfully removed from the custom category.

customCategoryName.description: The name of the custom category to delete. Must be 1-32 characters and must not contain: # ! @ $ % ^ * ? . / \. Example: "RegistrySeedCategory2"

actions.description: List and search endpoints (managed devices) with filtering.
actions.name: list-endpoints

id.description: Broad search query across endpoints by device, user and email identities that contain this string (case-insensitive).

emailId.description: Search by email ids that contain this string (case-insensitive).

deviceName.description: Search by device names that contain this string (case-insensitive).

userId.description: Search by user ids that contain this string (case-insensitive).

osVersion.description: Filter by this exact device OS version string.

status.description: Filter by this exact set of statuses.

debugState.description: Filter by this exact set of debug states. 0 means not in debug, 1 means debug request sent to endpoint, 2 means debug request acknowledged by endpoint.

locationId.description: Filter by this exact location id - with an underscore separating the case sensitive city and country values e.g. "City_Country".

agentVersion.description: Filter by this exact agent version.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

first.description: Number of records requested. The default value is 50.

actions.description: List all policies, paginated by name.
actions.name: list-policies

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

first.description: Number of records to request. Defaults to 50.

order.description: Sort order for policy names. Defaults to asc.

actions.description: Replace all URLs in a custom category
actions.name: replace-custom-category-urls

customCategoryName.description: Custom category name. Must be 1-32 characters and must not contain: # ! @ $ % ^ * ? . / \. Example: "RegistrySeedCategory1"

urls.description: URLs to replace in the category. Example: ["*.example.com", "*.other.com"]

actions.description: Upsert custom application bypasses, or toggle defaults, per platform.
actions.name: update-policy-application-bypasses

policyName.description: The name of the policy to update. Example: "RegistrySeedPolicy1"

inheritsFromBase.description: Set to true to reset the policy to inherit all application bypass configuration from the base policy.

custom.description: Custom application entries to upsert, keyed by platform.

name.description: The name of the application to bypass. Example: "MyApp.app"

note.description: Optional note about this bypass entry.

name.description: The name of the application to bypass. Example: "MyApp.app"

note.description: Optional note about this bypass entry.

default.description: Default application entries with updated toggle states, keyed by platform.

name.description: The name of the default bypass entry.

state.description: Whether this default entry is applied or ignored.

name.description: The name of the default bypass entry.

state.description: Whether this default entry is applied or ignored.

actions.description: Update the users and groups a policy is assigned to (replaces lists; omit a list to preserve it).
actions.name: update-policy-assignments

policyName.description: Name of the policy to update assignments for. Example: "RegistrySeedPolicy1"

users.description: User emails to assign. Omit to leave unchanged, send [] to unassign all.

groups.description: Group emails to assign. Omit to leave unchanged, send [] to unassign all.

actions.description: Add user/group-level restriction overrides per category; replaces all existing exceptions for the categories/customCategories supplied.
actions.name: update-policy-exceptions

policyName.description: Name of the policy to update exceptions for. Example: "RegistrySeedPolicy1"

categories.description: Exception updates keyed by category name, then by user or group identifier. Pass an empty object `{}` for a category to remove all exceptions from that category.

customCategories.description: Exception updates keyed by custom category name, then by user or group identifier. Pass an empty object `{}` for a category to remove all exceptions from that category.

actions.description: Update a policy's category restrictions (ALLOW/BLOCK/WARNING), or reset to base inheritance.
actions.name: update-policy-restrictions

policyName.description: Policy name. Max 32 characters, no special characters (#!@$%^*?./\). Example: "RegistrySeedPolicy1"

categories.description: Map of category names to restriction values.

actions.description: Set a custom SSL inspection state, or reset to inherit from the base policy (mutually exclusive).
actions.name: update-policy-ssl-inspection

state.description: Set a custom SSL inspection state. Mutually exclusive with inheritsFromBase.

inheritsFromBase.description: Reset to inherit from the base policy. Mutually exclusive with state.

actions.description: Update custom URL bypasses and toggle default URL bypass entries for a policy, or reset to base policy inheritance.
actions.name: update-policy-url-bypasses

policyName.description: Name of the policy to update URL bypasses for. Example: "RegistrySeedPolicy1"

inheritsFromBase.description: Set to true to reset URL bypass configuration to inherit from the Base Policy

custom.description: Custom URL bypass entries to upsert (matched by name)

name.description: URL pattern or name to bypass. Example: "*.example.com"

note.description: Optional note about this bypass entry

default.description: Default URL bypass entries to update toggle states

name.description: Name of the default bypass entry

state.description: Toggle state for this default entry
